highest_leverage_blocker.scope: Inspectable optional buyback announcement/payment and paid successful-resolution-only hand replacement; preserve normal Flashback and other existing recast paths.
highest_leverage_blocker.reason: Existing canonical scoped handoff already records Reiterate; reusable announcement/destination policy benefits the buyback family. This is the next focused shared capability, not a promise every buyback card becomes complete.

selection_changes.reason: Actual direct-search placement ignores zone replacements; revealed handles would incorrectly expose private finds. Whole private tutors remain unregistered. Same-family qualified substitutes use existing revealed handles and replacement-aware MoveCards, with no Engine/parser changes.
selection_changes.claim_order_note: The original family batch was claimed before implementation. During its released replan, unregistered replacement drafts were edited before the exact substitute identities were reclaimed; reclamation preceded scoped verification and registration. Sole writer, no overlapping ownership. Future continuation must claim exact substitute identities before any draft edit.

shared_prerequisite_changes.scope: Existing exact mana-source recognition accepts unqualified tap/self-sacrifice choose-color bodies as well as retained artifact-qualified bodies. No new primitive, parser or lowering.
shared_prerequisite_changes.reason: Printed self-reference cannot be strengthened to an artifact-only cost. Manual activation is not equivalent to optional resolving payment; the exact unqualified source must be usable in both windows.
shared_prerequisite_changes.integration: Completed separate focused prerequisite commit, then fifteen-card/queue integration. No additional card scope.
